Independent non-author receipt for awestruck-starchy-cowbird. Reviewed commit e1239ba84238f97ae352afcdaa0ad246b6d2384d against parent 710a606b6d38bafc0f2c6684711b08811d26529e. The exact five-path census, standalone-comment projection, shebang and directive preservation, Terraform formatting, ShellCheck, comment hygiene, diff integrity, ticket trailer, and both focused suites passed. The suites reported 38 and 68 passing tests. Exactly 29 changed maximal standalone-comment regions are cited below. The independent full-region word count fell from 2873 to 1193 words, and every row shrank. The authoring tally excluded retained lines inside several cited regions and is therefore lower, but reaches the same per-region result. Full local make verify remains intentionally deferred under the operator's documentation-only CI substitution.
